content: .{@-विशेष@} {%a.%} showing or making no difference, indiscriminating, without distinction; निर्विशेषा वयं त्वयि <ls>Mb.</ls>; निर्विशेषो विशेषः <ls>Bh. 3. 50</ls> ‘a difference without distinction’. .²2 having no difference, same, like, not differing from (<ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>); निर्विशेषाकृति ‘having the same form’; प्रवातनीलोत्पलनिर्विशेषम् <ls>Ku. 1. 46</ls>; स निर्विशेषप्रतिपत्तिरासीत् <ls>R. 14. 22</ls>. .²3 indiscriminate, promiscuous. . ({@-षः@}) absence of difference. (निर्विशेषम् and निर्विशेषेण are used adverbially in the sense of ‘without difference’, ‘equally’, ‘indiscriminately’; क्रुद्धेन विप्रमुक्तोऽयं निर्विशेषं प्रियाप्रिये <ls>Rām. 7. 22. 41</ls>. स्वगृहनिर्विशेषमत्र स्थीयताम् <ls>H. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 6.</ls>).
